automatedTests.environment: Local Node VM module runner; mocked browser APIs and provider transport

browser.reason: English experimental settings at the end of the signed-out options page, parent/child switches, performance warning and conditional connection-method visibility were visually verified in a localhost preview using mocked APIs. Real browser model performance and inference remain unverified.

api.reason: A model-discovery request was attempted with a user-supplied key held only in memory. The execution environment denied outbound network access with EACCES. No live key, email, or account data is included in source, test fixtures, diagnostics, or release files.

claude.reason: GET /v1/models was attempted against api.anthropic.com with the supplied key held only in process memory. Outbound access was denied with EACCES before any HTTP response. The key was cleared from memory; source, fixtures, diagnostics, and release files contain no supplied credential or account email.

credentialScan.scope: Project source, tests, documentation, generated privacy HTML and packaged extension

onDeviceAI.supportedLanguages: Runtime availability probes for output targets and source/target configurations, including English instructions
onDeviceAI.processingLocation: Determined by the browser; availability does not guarantee on-device execution
onDeviceAI.manualChecks: Follow TESTING.md on each intended browser/device; actual Samsung compatibility is unverified.
onDeviceAI.experimentalOptIn: Settings > Experimental features > Enable On-Device AI; both default off, including legacy settings. Capability probes, connection selection, setup and inference are gated. Disabling either switch stops active native work without switching providers.
onDeviceAI.performanceNotice: May be very slow and unstable depending on PC specifications; localized in English and Korean.

translatorAPI.availabilityDetection: Translator.availability per listed language pair, independent of browser identity and Prompt API
translatorAPI.sourceDetection: Popup: chrome.tabs.detectLanguage when Translator is supported; automatic translation: chrome.i18n.detectLanguage with a declared page-language fallback. Explicit per-page source selection takes precedence.
translatorAPI.manualChecks: Follow TESTING.md; actual browser extension/model execution remains unverified.
translatorAPI.packManagement: Tracks pairs prepared by this extension and queries availability; the browser API has no complete installed-pack inventory or uninstall operation. Remove from list deletes only the saved pair record.

nativeBackground.execution: Packaged same-origin iframe controlled by an offscreen runtime-messaging host
nativeBackground.tabClosureAfterReadiness: Covered for both providers by mocked integration tests
nativeBackground.restartRecovery: Persistent text-free readiness; lazy host recreation
nativeBackground.fallback: Explicit visible-tab requirement when hidden preparation fails

sourceLanguage.scope: Per tab and document in session storage; cleared on navigation/reload/tab closure
sourceLanguage.native: Supported source/target choices only; source may be Auto
sourceLanguage.missingPack: Opens or reuses setup for the required pair; retry after preparation
